split.test_policy: each formulation is held out once per repeat; all replicate experiments for a formulation stay together
split.source_policy: source model is fit only on development formulations; held-out target formulations are excluded at every source temperature
split.development_source_feature_policy: fivefold cross-fitted source predictions for target-training formulations; full-development source model only for held-out formulations

inference.multiplicity: one_frozen_primary_edge; three temperature-distance controls and one shuffled-source placebo

primary_hypothesis.rationale: An adjacent-temperature conductivity model learned from a label-rich formulation slice should provide a selective local prior that materially reduces the labels needed at the coldest, deliberately data-poor target slice.

interpretation_policy.allowed_if_all_gates_pass: within-campaign local-neighbor rescue under strict formulation-level leakage control
not_allowed: direct evidence that an entire scientific field is rescued
interpretation_policy.required_context: Report together with independent cross-dataset nulls to establish selectivity and with explicit statement that independent replication of the rescue edge remains future work.

decision_rule: Call the frozen adjacent-temperature edge a local rescue only if all practical-effect, uncertainty, absolute-utility, fold-direction, learner-robustness, source-quality, leakage, permutation, sample-equivalence, adjacency, and placebo gates pass. Otherwise retain the exact failed gates and do not choose a new primary edge.
